description: A painted outdoor scene: a dark wooden desk on a sunlit lawn in front of a white columned building with an American flag on a pole. On the desk an open leather folder holds a document with a lettered header and a scribbled signature, a gold pen lies beside it, and a framed photo of a man in a suit speaking at a podium stands behind. Rows of empty folding chairs sit on the grass to the left.
reason: The document on the desk has a visible lettered header that reads like a bill number (H.R. 3706) with a caption beneath and a signature. Painted text must go; the document should be blank or show only unreadable marks.
